metadata.case_name: HA KIT YING KITTY v. NG KA KI

plaintiff.occupation_before: Office secretary (daytime) and part-time beer promoter (night)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Office secretary (resumed daytime job; did not resume part-time beer promoter)

injuries.description: a compression fracture of the L1 vertebra.
source: a compression fracture of the L1 vertebra.
Subsequent X-rays showed anterior wedging deformity with some reduction of anterior and right vertebral height in L1 body, compatible with the fracture.
There was also minimal lateral deviation of the backbone with slight left convexity at the fractured region.

injuries.description: soft tissue swelling over the mid-shin of her left leg.
source: soft tissue swelling over the mid-shin of her left leg.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified parts of lower leg

manifestations.description: Soreness after standing or walking for about an hour
Needs to lean back for support after sitting for over an hour and a half
Pain increases during weather change and menstruation
Mild tenderness over the thoraco-lumbar junction
No neurological deficit in either limb
Scoliosis and kyphosis at L1 as well as increased lordosis in the rest of the lumbar spine; normal alignment was affected
Paraspinal muscle guarding, tightness and tenderness, more severe on the left side
Some but likely mild decrease in the endurance for prolonged walking and standing, and some decrease in the endurance for prolonged and continuous handling of heavier objects
Traction and onset of pain when she bends her body to wash hair and to wash the dog
Soft tissue swelling over the mid-shin of her left leg (noted after the accident)

losses.description: Compression fracture of L1 resulting in residual impairment and disability at the back.
Some decrease in endurance for prolonged walking and standing and decreased endurance for prolonged handling of heavier objects.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Causes some adjustment in her pre-accident daily and sport activities.
Unable to resume her pre-accident part-time job as a beer promoter due to prolonged standing and handling of weights.
